name: august
description: Local-first meeting transcription with whisper.cpp — web app and Electron desktop shell
author: vladdobro

scripts.predev: npm run setup || echo whisper setup failed - transcription stays unavailable until npm run setup succeeds
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n server,client,electron "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run electron:dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run electron:compile
